description: Retrieve the complete Architectural Property Dossier for a specific property_id (or Realtor listing URL), including multi-provider AVM valuations (Quantarium, Collateral, CoreLogic), 37+ high-res photos, county tax assessment history, prior sale/price-change events, assigned school ratings, HOA fees, and listing broker info. Cost: 10 Credits / call (0 Credits if not found).

property_id.description: MLS / MPR property_id (e.g. "8241233717") or full Realtor.com listing URL.

name: get_property_valuation_and_comps

code.description: Status code (0 for success, -1 for error).

data.description: Complete Architectural Property Dossier with multi-AVM valuation, photos, tax/deed history, and underwriting metrics.

property.description: Detailed normalized property record including list_price, estimated_value, instant_equity_pct, specs, proptech_metrics, valuations, tax_history, property_history, nearby_schools, photos, and agent.

meta.description: Request execution metadata including request ID, credits charged, cache status, and latency.

cached.description: Whether the response was served from the 6-hour write-through cache.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on empty or error).

request_id.description: Unique UUID identifying this API request.

took_ms.description: Total gateway execution time in milliseconds.

title: Get Full Property Valuation (AVM), 37-Photo Gallery, Tax & Deed History
